dedupe_keys.name: hydrogen cps digital twin intrusion detection dataset liquid hydrogen logistics telemetry scada and network indicators with attack and leakage labels

description: This Zenodo dataset gives multivariate time series for a hydrogen logistics cyber-physical system that joins cryogenic storage and transfer, SCADA and PLC control, industrial IoT sensing, tanker fleet telemetry and network security indicators. It is meant for research on joint cyber intrusion detection and physical safety monitoring in a digital-twin setting, where twin and process states may diverge during abnormal events. Each row is a timestamped observation for a terminal, tanker and sensor node, with cryogenic tank readings such as liquid hydrogen and vapour temperature, pressure and its rise rate, boil-off, fill level, heat ingress and wall stress, together with control and authentication signals, network behaviour, twin synchronisation variables and engineered risk indices. Labels are an imbalanced intrusion class (normal, SCADA valve spoofing, sensor malware, PLC firmware intrusion, fleet route hijacking and digital twin tampering) and a continuous leakage rate in kg per hour. A 112 MB zip of CSV files is available for free download under CC BY 4.0, published in early 2026 by a single named author. Coverage is not tied to a real site. Caveats: the record does not say whether values come from a real plant or a simulation, and no paper or provider affiliation is given. Simulation uses are training and testing intrusion and leak detection for hydrogen supply chain control systems. Related records: data-iec104-scada-ids-dataset is another control-system intrusion dataset.
